title: Medicare and Medicaid Programs: CY 2020 Hospital Outpatient PPS Policy Changes and Payment Rates and Ambulatory Surgical Center Payment System Policy Changes and Payment Rates. Price Transparency Requirements for Hospitals To Make Standard Charges Public
officialText: This final rule updates payment policies and establishes requirements for hospitals in the United States to make their standard charges public. Federal Register document 2019-24931 identifies the published instrument.

title: Transparency in Coverage
issuer: Internal Revenue Service; Employee Benefits Security Administration; Department of Health and Human Services
officialText: The Transparency in Coverage regulations establish requirements for group health plans and health insurance issuers in the individual and group markets to disclose cost-sharing information upon request. They also require disclosure of in-network negotiated rates and historical out-of-network allowed amounts. Federal Register document 2020-24591 identifies the published final rule.

title: Procurement Act 2023
officialText: 2023 chapter 54, Procurement Act 2023. This Act applies to a contracting authority carrying out a covered procurement. A contracting authority must have regard to delivering value for money and acting with integrity. The provisions come into force in accordance with commencement regulations. The official instrument is published by legislation.gov.uk under the identity ukpga/2023/54.

title: Online Safety Act 2023
officialText: 2023 chapter 50, Online Safety Act 2023. This Act applies to a provider of a regulated user-to-user service or regulated search service with links to the United Kingdom. A provider shall operate proportionate systems and processes to protect individuals from illegal content. OFCOM may enforce the duties under this Act.

title: Building Safety Act 2022
officialText: 2022 chapter 30, Building Safety Act 2022. This Act applies to an accountable person for a higher-risk building. The accountable person must assess building safety risks and shall take reasonable steps to prevent a building safety risk materialising. The regulator may enforce these duties.

title: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive
officialText: Directive (EU) 2022/2464 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 December 2022 amends specified Union acts as regards corporate sustainability reporting. CELEX 32022L2464 identifies the instrument.

title: Protection of persons who report breaches of Union law
officialText: Directive (EU) 2019/1937 applies to reporting persons working in the private or public sector who acquired information on breaches in a work-related context. Member States shall ensure that legal entities establish channels and procedures for internal reporting and follow-up. Member States shall bring into force the laws necessary to comply by December 17, 2021. CELEX 32019L1937 identifies the instrument.

title: Accessibility requirements for products and services
officialText: Directive (EU) 2019/882 applies to listed products and services placed on the market or provided to consumers in the European Union. Economic operators shall ensure that covered products and services comply with the accessibility requirements. Microenterprises providing services shall be exempt from those requirements. Member States shall apply the measures from June 28, 2025. CELEX 32019L0882 identifies the instrument.
